query:
INSERT INTO products (categoryId, name, slug, description, basePrice, isCustomizable, inStock, featured, displayOrder, productType, imageUrl) 
SELECT id, 'Freeze Dried Milk Duds', 'freeze-dried-milk-duds', 'Classic Milk Duds transformed into crunchy caramel balls! The chocolate and caramel become light and airy with an irresistible crunch.', '8.00', 0, 1, 1, 9, 'standard', '/images/freeze-dried-milk-duds.png' FROM categories WHERE slug = 'freeze-dried-candy';
